what: Headless rerun of the righting sim (kedge/sim_righting/index.html simCore, unchanged) with the v34 geometry (dart-cad4, 9 Nov 2026): leg 113 mm hinge to pad, hinge x 33 z 14.5, pad 37 wide, leg 5.5 g; pods at x 132, z 9.5, stop 46.75 deg, 26 g each; hull 191 g with its CG at x 83.4, 3.3 mm below the axis (whole dart 249 g, CG z -0.15); random landing poses, rover 3 m.
